comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: I cant change the colour of this, yet I see others wearing different colours of these. How is this possible?

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Perhaps the color of the hat is random when obtained.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: That puzzled me for a while, too. This hat cannot be color-customized; however, it shares its model with Scalawag Hat -- the yellow-blue-red scalawags made via sewing and a World Clock recipe can be color-changed, while the purple and green hats (whose colors are permanent) are Ganador related.
